messages:
max: Quick idea  Retro Rumble this Friday? CRT corner + projector, BYO controller or use spares. short casual tourney and mystery key envelopes. anyone in? :joystick:

sophie: i'm so in. can bring a couple of USB adapters and a mini multi-out for older pads.

eli: love it. i'll bring my N64 with GoldenEye and a box of gummies.

tori: i can handle sign-ups and a tiny Google sheet. what time? 6:30/7/8?

poll-bot: POLL by max  "Start time" Options: "6:30pm", "7pm", "8pm". Votes: Max (7pm), Sophie (7pm), Eli (6:30pm), Tori (7pm), Dan (7pm).

max: 7pm then. logistics: one mystery key per person, remote raffle for two keys. i'll hide envelopes at the welcome table.

dan: snack plan? i'll bring plain pizza. someone bring napkins.

sophie: i'll bring a small adapter kit and label everything. also please no greasy fingers on controllers.

eli: travel-router? last time NAT was annoying for local server pairing. i can bring one and a tiny config:
```
# travel-router quick
set mode=router
enable dhcp
ssid RedwoodRetro
```

facilities-bot: Mezzanine reserved 7pm-11pm. Please return chairs and wipe surfaces after event.

tori: sheet link: https://sheets.example.com/s/retro-rumble-signup (i'll pin it). pls add controller needs.

max: final: keep volume down after 10:30, tidy up, label gear. see y'all Friday :partyparrot:

sophie: pumped! might bring a silly hat for the first-key bonus.

dan: i'll bring extra power strips. see you!
